summary: Iterasi 11.3 REVISI feature tested end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend UI). All 7 pytest cases pass and all UI flows work (Budi as pemberi can send revisi via Monitor dialog while other fields are disabled; Rina as penerima sees red revisi-banner with catatan + pemberi name + count, can change select-status back to Selesai and REVISI badge disappears; Siti as non-pemberi is blocked with 403 backend; SPV can send revisi in any workspace after switching to correct divisi). Kanban card-revisi and Table row-revisi badges render correctly. Tugas Rutin Tracker regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >700 lines; consider splitting into routers per resource (tasks/auth/rutin) for maintainability.
RevisiPayload uses min_length=1 (good). Consider also stripping whitespace to reject pure-space catatan.
revisi_count is $inc'd only on POST /revisi. If SPV re-calls repeatedly, count keeps rising — this is expected behavior per spec.
